name: Clara
tagline: Listens to you present over your slides and gives a per-slide breakdown of your speaking.

awards: MLH || Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry || Digital Gift Card

problem: Students rehearse presentations without useful feedback.
solution: Upload slides and context, present naturally; word-level timestamps are analysed per slide and overall.
demo_moment: Team-described: present and read slide-by-slide feedback.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “MLH || Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry || Digital Gift Card” among 231 submissions.

lessons: Anchor feedback to the artefact the user can change.
